_meta.source: PokeTools VGC 2026 Reg M-B tier list, derived from Smogon ladder usage
_meta.fields: Most-used item, nature, four moves, ability, ability usage percentage, fixed IVs, and most-used Pokémon Champions Stat Point spread.
_meta.important_note: These are ladder most-used sets, not hand-curated recommendations. Very low-usage entries can contain source placeholders such as Nothing; those are preserved and flagged.
_meta.sp_note: Pokémon Champions uses Stat Points (SP), not the main-series EV system. The stat_points field stores the most-used August 2026 Reg M-B ladder spread reported by PokeTools. IVs are stored separately as fixed 31 in all six stats.
_meta.mechanics_note: Pokémon Champions uses fixed 31 IVs in all six stats. Competitive investment is represented by Stat Points (SP), max 32 per stat and 66 total. PokeTools labels these ladder spreads as 'EV spread'; this JSON stores them as stat_points.
_meta.ability_note: ability and ability_usage_percent come from the same August 2026 Pokémon Champions Reg M-B ladder profile as the selected most-used spread.
_meta.completion: 277 / 277 ranked entries include ability, fixed IVs, and Champions stat_points.

mechanics.ivs: Pokémon Champions calculates all six stats as if IV = 31.
mechanics.stat_points: 0–32 per stat, 66 total; these replace the traditional EV investment system.

_meta.spread_source: Most-used Stat Point spread from the August 2026 VGC 2026 Reg M-B Pokémon Champions ladder profile for each ranked Pokémon/form.
